steps.title: Verify Metadata and Package Structures
steps.description: Validate the package name 'com.picblendcompare.app' and app name configuration in app-meta.json

steps.title: Clean Build Configurations
steps.description: Update build.gradle to ensure strict compatibility with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5, and remove unnecessary external dependencies to maintain a clean built-in workspace

steps.title: Validate Android Manifest and Theme Settings
steps.description: Double check AndroidManifest.xml package declarations and the default Light Material theme integration

steps.title: Optimize Main Layout Scrolling
steps.description: Embed the control panel layout inside a ScrollView to prevent display overflows or clipping on smaller devices or landscape modes

steps.title: Update Image Sandbox Resource Resolution
steps.description: Upgrade ImageSandboxView to use compile-time safe R.drawable references instead of dynamic string lookup

steps.title: Reinforce Drawing Color Filters
steps.description: Ensure the active color filters are correctly applied during every single draw phase, regardless of the active comparison mode

steps.title: Optimize Seekbar Synchronization
steps.description: Incorporate 'fromUser' flags inside MainActivity's seekbar change listeners to eliminate redundant slider callback draw loops

steps.title: Refine Color Filter Button Styling
steps.description: Verify selector button state rendering and update UI text displays dynamically based on current selected attributes

steps.title: Audit Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Check the code to verify that no lambdas, method references, or streams are used, maintaining full backwards compatibility

steps.title: Building PicBlend Compare
steps.description: Assemble and compile the debug package of PicBlend Compare securely and run final validation checks
